LOW.001.short: Prepare for Mass and follow the local Low-Mass posture. The opening Sign of the Cross and Introibo at the foot of the altar are your first reliable landmarks.

LOW.002.short: The priest begins the prayers at the foot of the altar. Remain recollected and follow the opening prayer sequence if you wish.

LOW.003.short: The preparatory prayers continue at the foot of the altar. The Confiteor and the visible striking of the breast are the next clear landmarks.

LOW.004.short: The Confiteor sequence is ending. Watch for the priest to leave the foot of the altar and ascend the steps.

LOW.005.short: The priest ascends the altar and says the quiet altar prayers. Watch for him to move to the Epistle side for the Introit.

LOW.006.short: The Introit begins the Proper of the Mass. Follow the text if you wish; the Kyrie and the priest’s movement toward the centre come next.

LOW.007.short: Ordinary begins. Watch next for Gloria intonation if appointed; otherwise Dominus vobiscum for Collect.

LOW.008.short: Major Ordinary landmark. Watch next for Priest turns/says Dominus vobiscum, then goes to Epistle side for Collect.

LOW.009.short: Opening oration. Watch next for Epistle begins with priest still at Epistle side.

LOW.010.short: Scripture reading. Watch next for Server response / priest begins Gradual/Alleluia text.

LOW.011.short: Transition toward Gospel. Watch next for Priest moves to center/Gospel side and begins Gospel preparation.

LOW.012.short: Gospel is imminent. Watch next for Dóminus vobíscum / Sequéntia sancti Evangélii.

LOW.013.short: Public Gospel. Watch next for Return toward center / Credo if appointed / Offertory if not.

LOW.014.short: Creed landmark. Watch next for Dóminus vobíscum, then Orémus introducing Offertory.

LOW.015.short: Offertory begins. Watch next for Priest uncovers chalice / prepares bread and wine.

LOW.016.short: Offertory prayers are underway. Watch next for Orate fratres turn.

LOW.017.short: Offertory is ending; Secret follows. Watch next for Quiet follows as Secret begins.

LOW.018.short: Secret is not an audible navigation text/chant. Watch next for Public Per ómnia sæcula sæculórum / Amen, then Preface dialogue.

LOW.019.short: One of the strongest auditory landmarks. Watch next for Sanctus begins; altar bell may sound.

LOW.020.short: Canon is about to begin. Watch next for Sudden drop into silence / Canon + pre-Consecration warning.

LOW.021.short: Silent Canon underway. Watch next for Warning bell shortly before Consecration.

LOW.022.short: Consecration is imminent; remain kneeling/recollected. Watch next for Host elevation bells.

LOW.023.short: You are exactly at the elevation of the Sacred Host. Watch next for Chalice elevation bell after the intervening consecration.

LOW.024.short: You are exactly at the elevation of the Precious Blood. Watch next for Canon returns to silence; later Nobis quoque can become audible.

LOW.025.short: Useful mid/late-Canon landmark. Watch next for Public Per omnia at the end of Canon.

LOW.026.short: Canon has ended; Communion rites begin. Watch next for Pax Domini / Agnus Dei.

LOW.027.short: Communion preparation. Watch next for Communion warning bell if faithful will receive.

LOW.028.short: Communicants prepare/approach when directed. Watch next for Ecce Agnus Dei facing the people.

LOW.029.short: Faithful Communion rite is beginning. Watch next for Actual distribution at rail.

LOW.030.short: Distribution is in progress. Watch next for Priest returns to altar and begins ablutions.

LOW.031.short: Communion section is closing. Watch next for Dóminus vobíscum before Postcommunion.

LOW.032.short: Closing prayer. Watch next for Final Dóminus vobíscum / dismissal.

LOW.033.short: Mass is reaching formal conclusion. Watch next for Blessing if the rite includes it.

LOW.034.short: Kneel/sign yourself according to established practice. Watch next for Priest moves to Gospel side for Last Gospel if present.

LOW.035.short: Last major landmark. Watch next for Priest leaves altar / recessional.

Old long guides include visibly templated or awkward copy: preserve full text in Ultra Master workbook without publishing it.
No user or priest gesture can be inferred from a stage title; rubrics and posture profiles retain ownership.
